# PokéBonk

> Free 3D Pokémon-style survivor fan game you play in the browser. This site is an English SEO/GEO hub that embeds the playable game from pokebonk.com and explains how to play on a single scrollable page.

## Entity
- Name: PokéBonk
- Type: Unofficial fan browser game (3D survivor / Vampire Survivors–like with Pokémon-style characters)
- Roster: ~151 Kanto Pokémon (as mentioned on the official game site; verify in-game)
- Modes: Classic and Survival (per public guides)
- Controls: WASD movement; auto-attacks; evolve; Ultimates; League progression
- Starters: Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle
- Official play URL: https://pokebonk.com/?lang=en
- This hub: https://hwlvipone.github.io/pokebonk/
- Status: NOT affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures, or The Pokémon Company

## How to play (summary)
1. Open https://pokebonk.com/?lang=en (or use the Play embed on this hub). Guest play supported.
2. Pick a starter and Classic or Survival mode.
3. Move with WASD; attacks fire automatically — dodge hordes and collect power.
4. Evolve, use Ultimates, and push toward League challenges (exact unlocks may change).

## Disclaimer
PokéBonk is an unofficial fan game. Pokémon and related trademarks belong to their respective owners. Do not invent rankings, player counts, or features beyond public guides and the live game.
